title: Avalyn Completes Target Enrollment in Phase 2b MIST Trial of AP01 (Inhaled Pirfenidone) for Patients with Progressive Pulmonary Fibrosis
author: Na
description: Avalyn Pharma announced completion of target enrollment of 375 patients in the Phase 2b MIST clinical trial of AP01 (inhaled pirfenidone) for progressive pulmonary fibrosis. The global, randomized, double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial is evaluating two doses of AP01 against placebo, with primary endpoint measuring change in lung function at 52 weeks. Topline data is expected in the second half of 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company achieved a significant clinical milestone by completing target enrollment ahead of schedule in a Phase 2b trial for a serious respiratory disease with high unmet medical need. The trial completion demonstrates strong investigator and patient enthusiasm, and prior Phase 1b data showed encouraging safety profiles. Topline results expected in H2 2027 provide near-term catalyst for investors.

title: Avalyn Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights
author: Not Specified
description: Avalyn Pharma, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, announced Q1 2026 financial results and pipeline updates following its May 2026 IPO that raised $345 million in gross proceeds. The company is on track to complete enrollment of its MIST Phase 2b trial of AP01 (inhaled pirfenidone) for progressive pulmonary fibrosis by mid-2026, with topline data expected in H2 2027. Long-term open-label extension data presented at EULAR showed favorable tolerability over four years. AP02 (inhaled nintedanib) enrollment is underway in the AURA Phase 2 trial with results anticipated by end of 2027. The company projects its cash position of $123.1 million plus $316.1 million in IPO proceeds will fund operations into 2029.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company successfully completed an upsized IPO raising $345 million, demonstrating investor confidence. Pipeline programs are progressing on schedule with enrollment on track and multiple clinical data presentations supporting favorable tolerability profiles. Strong cash position projected to fund operations into 2029 provides runway for clinical development. Long-term extension data showing sustained tolerability and favorable lung function trends support the therapeutic potential of lead candidates.
